```{r, message = F, warning = F}
# load packages outside of simulation
library(papaja)
library(patchwork)
#source required functions & parameters
source('../../../R/functions.R')
source('../../../R/parameters.R')
```

```{r}
# load results
resultsSVNP_hyper <- read_rds("../../../output/resultsSVNP_hyper.RDS")
convSVNP_hyper <- read_rds("../../../output/convSVNP_hyper.RDS")

```

```{r}
resultsSVNP_hyper <- 
  resultsSVNP_hyper %>% 
  group_by(N, cross, iteration) %>% 
  mutate(
         biasCrossMean_1 = abs(crossEstMean_1 - cross),
         biasCrossMean_2 = abs(crossEstMean_2 - 0),
         biasCrossMean_3 = abs(crossEstMean_3 - 0),
         biasCrossMean_4 = abs(crossEstMean_4 - 0),
         biasCrossMean_5 = abs(crossEstMean_5 - 0),
         biasCrossMean_6 = abs(crossEstMean_6 - cross),
         SigmaEstMean = SigmaEstMean,
         SigmaEstMed = SigmaEstMed,
         SigmaSquEstMean = SigmaEstMean^2,
         SigmaSquEstMed = SigmaEstMed^2
         ) 

  
```

# summarise mean sigmaSqu per condtion
```{r}
resultsSVNP_hyper %>% 
  group_by(N, cross)%>% 
  summarise(sigmaSquMean = mean(SigmaSquEstMean),
           SigmaSquEstMed = mean(SigmaSquEstMed)) 

# write output for table 
write_rds(resultsSVNP_hyper, "../../figures/sigmaSqu_per_cond.RDS")
```
# plot bias against Sigma

```{r}
Sigma_squ_bias_100_02 <- 
resultsSVNP_hyper %>% 
  filter(N == 100, cross == 0.2) %>% 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = SigmaSquEstMean, y = biasCrossMean_1))+
  geom_point()
Sigma_squ_bias_100_02
```

```{r}
Sigma_squ_bias_200_02 <-
```


# main plot bias

```{r}
allAtOnce <- Sigma_squ_bias_100_02 + Sigma_squ_bias_200_02 + Sigma_squ_bias_100_05 + Sigma_squ_bias_200_05 
allAtOnce + plot_layout(guides = "collect", ncol = 2) & theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank())
```


```{r}
biasSigma <- allAtOnce + plot_layout(guides = "collect", ncol = 2) & theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank())
saveRDS(biasSigma, file = "../../figures/biasAllParsRHSPInc.Rds")
```
